## How can we do it?  {#how .center}

:::{.fragment}
GTFShift bus lane prioritization tool provides <b>aggregated metrics</b> for <b>speed</b> at <b>road segment level</b> per <b>hour</b>
:::

## {#how-image background-image="static/backgrounds/gtfshift_dashboard.png"}

## How can we do it?  {#how-2 .center .smaller}

We can use those metrics to determine a <b>Disturbance Index</b> adjusted to the speed, comparing the <b>median</b> travel of each segment, with the <b>Percentile 75</b> (or 85), assumed to be the <b>freeflow</b> speed:

:::{.fragment}
$$DI_{speed} = \frac{speed_{median} - speed_{P75}}{speed_{P75}}$$

> Its value, can be interpreted as: <br/>
> <= -0.2 Much slower (than freeflow) 
> \[-0.2; -0.05[ Slower (than freeflow)  <br/>
> [-0.05; 0.05] Regular speed <br/>
> \]0.05; 0.2\[ Faster (than freeflow) 
>  \>= 0.2 much faster (than freeflow) 
:::
